contentList.content: Grit

A gunslinger's pool of nerve and daring. Spend Grit to fuel trick shots and desperate gambits. Grit is restored to its maximum after a long rest, and you regain 1 point whenever you score a critical hit or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a firearm attack.
Flintlock Cylinder
Shots loaded in your main-hand flintlock. Spend 1 to fire; a short or long rest also refills it.
Offhand Flintlock Cylinder
Shots loaded in your offhand flintlock. Spend 1 to fire; a short or long rest also refills it.
Blunderbuss Shot
Shots loaded in your equipped blunderbuss. Spend 1 to fire; a short or long rest also refills it.
Musket Cartridge
Shots loaded in your equipped musket. Spend 1 to fire; a short or long rest also refills it.
Gunsmithing Charges
The number of firearms and gunsmithing kits you can assemble from raw materials before you must rest and restock components. Restores to maximum after a long rest.
Gunslinger
A firearm-focused duelist who fuels trick shots and desperate gambits with Grit, a pool of nerve and daring that recharges after a long rest.
Grit Recovery
Regain one Grit point when you reduce a creature to 0 hit points or a firearm attack critically hits. Once per attack: a critical kill, or several kills from one attack, restore only one Grit point.
Grit Abilities
Choose from the grit abilities unlocked by your Gunslinger levels.
Spell Slots
You gain new Arcane Gunsman spell slots. Spell slots are restored after a long rest, and each spell you learn can be cast with any slot of its level or higher.
Spellcasting
You can cast Arcane Gunsman spells using Intelligence. You gain 1st-level spell slots, restored after a long rest.
Specialization
A patient sharpshooter who specializes in accurate, high-range attacks that deal heavy damage. Strongest when enemies are kept at a distance.
Marksman
Marksman
A bold gunfighter who makes greater use of Grit, spending it on special effects and versatile combat techniques.
Desperado
Desperado
A spellcasting gunfighter who imbues shots with magical effects. Intelligence is the Arcane Gunsman's spellcasting ability.
Arcane Gunsman
Arcane Gunsman
Gunner
Gain proficiency with firearms. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Firearm Proficiency
You are proficient with firearms.
Firearm Training
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Quick Reload
When dual-wielding two Flintlocks, you can reload both as a bonus action instead of an action. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Quick Reload
Full Reload of dual-wielded Flintlocks costs a bonus action, or an action if you have no bonus action left.
Quick Reload
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Full Reload of dual-wielded Flintlocks costs a bonus action instead of an action, or an action if you have no bonus action left.
Grit Adept
Increase your maximum grit points by 2 and choose one grit ability available to a level 3 Gunslinger.
Grit Adept
Increases your maximum grit points by 2.
Close-Quarters Gunner
Firearm attacks no longer have Disadvantage against targets within 5 feet of you. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Close-Quarters Gunner
Your firearm attacks don't have Disadvantage against targets within [1].
Steady Hands
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Longarm Specialist
Musket attacks gain 20 feet (6m) of range. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Longarm Specialist
Your musket attacks gain [1] of range.
Long Range Training
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Called Shot

Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a firearm from at least 30 feet away, it suffers Disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Called Shot
Disadvantage on your next attack roll.
Called Shot
Once per turn, a firearm hit from 30 feet or more away gives the target Disadvantage on its next attack roll.
Marksman's Eye
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Spellshot Adept
Your firearm attacks count as magical. Once per turn after casting a spell, your next firearm hit deals an extra 1d4 force damage. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Spellshot
Your firearm attacks count as magical.
Spellshot Charged
Your next firearm hit before the end of your next turn deals an extra 1d4 Force damage.
Spellshot Adept
Once per turn, after you cast a spell, your next firearm hit deals an extra 1d4 Force damage.
Spellshot Adept
Deals the stored Spellshot bonus damage.
Arcane Marksmanship
Increases your Intelligence score by 1.
Merciless Shot
Unlocks the Merciless Shot grit ability.
Merciless Shot
Your next firearm attack deals extra damage.
Merciless Shot
Choose 1, 2, or 3 grit points and make a firearm attack as an action. Each grit point adds half the weapon attack's damage. Consumes one bullet.
Line 'em Up
Unlocks the Line 'em Up grit ability.
Line 'em Up

Spend an action and 2 grit points. Enemies and neutral creatures in a 20-foot line take half your firearm's weapon damage, or a quarter on a successful Dexterity save. Save DC: 8 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus.
Rapid Shot
Unlocks the Rapid Shot grit ability.
Rapid Shot
You can make another firearm attack as a bonus action.
Rapid Shot
Spend 1 grit point to fire again as a bonus action.
Bite the Bullet
Unlocks the Bite the Bullet grit ability.
Bite the Bullet

Choose 1, 2, or 3 grit points as a bonus action. Gain <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag> equal to the grit spent multiplied by your proficiency bonus. Temporary hit points do not stack.
Shot in the Dark
Unlocks the Shot in the Dark grit ability.
Shot in the Dark
You have Darkvision and ignore the Blinded condition.
Shot in the Dark
As a bonus action, spend 1 grit point to gain Darkvision out to 60 feet and ignore Blindness for 10 turns.
Rapid Repair
Unlocks the Rapid Repair grit ability.
Rapid Repair
When one of your firearms is misfired, its Repair menu also offers Rapid Repair: spend a bonus action and 1 grit point to make a DC 18 Sleight of Hand check that clears the misfire.
Repair: Main Hand
Repair: Off Hand
Clear the misfire on the firearm in this hand. Rapid Repair appears here once you know it.
Repair
Make a DC 15 Sleight of Hand check to clear this firearm's misfire. A failed check spends the action but does not repair the firearm. A broken firearm cannot be repaired until your next long rest.
Spend 1 grit point and make a DC 18 Sleight of Hand check to clear this firearm's misfire. A failed check spends the bonus action and grit but does not repair the firearm.
Tinkerer

Use an action to modify your primary or secondary firearm: double its ammunition capacity, add 1d4 to its damage rolls, or increase its range. Modifications persist through long rests until replaced or removed with Remove Modification.
Tinkered: Capacity
This firearm holds twice its base ammunition capacity until this modification is replaced or removed.
Tinkered: Damage
Add 1d4 to this Flintlock's damage rolls until this modification is replaced or removed.
Add 1d4 to this Blunderbuss's damage rolls until this modification is replaced or removed.
Add 1d4 to this Musket's damage rolls until this modification is replaced or removed.
Tinkered: Range
This Flintlock's range is increased by 20 feet until this modification is replaced or removed.
This Blunderbuss's range is increased by 10 feet until this modification is replaced or removed.
This Musket's range is increased by 40 feet until this modification is replaced or removed.
Tinker Master: Ammo
This firearm holds three times its base ammunition capacity until this modification is replaced or removed.
Tinker Master: Damage
Add 2d4 to this Flintlock's damage rolls until this modification is replaced or removed.
Add 2d4 to this Blunderbuss's damage rolls until this modification is replaced or removed.
Add 2d4 to this Musket's damage rolls until this modification is replaced or removed.
Tinker Master: Range
This Flintlock's range is increased by 40 feet until this modification is replaced or removed.
This Blunderbuss's range is increased by 20 feet until this modification is replaced or removed.
This Musket's range is increased by 80 feet until this modification is replaced or removed.
Flintlock
Blunderbuss
Musket
Firearm
Tinkerer

Spend an action to modify the primary or secondary firearm. Choose capacity, damage, or range, or use Remove Modification to clear all upgrades on that firearm. Each physical gun keeps one upgrade (two from level 10 with Master Tinkerer) through long rests; repeating an upgrade with Master Tinkerer grants its Tinker Master tier, and a third upgrade replaces the oldest one.
Fanning Fire
Unlocks the Fanning Fire grit ability.
Fanning Fire

Spend 1-3 grit points and an action to fire 2-4 shots. Each shot has an attack-roll penalty equal to 1 + the grit spent (-2, -3 or -4) and consumes one bullet. You must have ammunition for the entire volley.
Desperado's Luck
Once per turn, when a firearm attack would miss, spend 1 grit point to add 1d4 to the roll. This interrupt does not spend a Reaction point.
Second Attack
You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.
Broken
This firearm is broken and cannot fire until your next long rest. It cannot be repaired by any other means.
Double Load

Spend an action, 1 grit point, and two bullets to make a firearm attack that deals an extra 1d4 damage with a Flintlock, or 1d6 with a Blunderbuss or Musket. A natural 1 destroys this physical gun until a long rest. Rapid Repair cannot restore it.
Double Load
Unlocks the Double Load grit ability.
Close Call
+2 Armor Class against the triggering attack.
Close Call
As a reaction, spend 2 grit points to gain +2 AC against an attack. If the attack misses, you automatically make a firearm attack against the attacker.
Close Call
Unlocks the Close Call grit ability.
Last Word

Once per long rest, spend a bonus action and 3 grit points to arm Last Word until your next long rest. The next time you would be downed, you stay at 1 hit point instead and immediately make one firearm attack against your attacker.
Last Word (Spent)
Last Word has already been used this long rest.
Last Word
Unlocks the Last Word grit ability.
Lock-on

As a bonus action, lock on to a creature. Your firearm attacks deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus to it. Requires concentration and can be used once per short rest. If the target dies before your concentration ends, you can lock on to a new target as a bonus action without using another short rest use.
Long Shot
Once per turn, deal additional damage based on the distance to your target when you hit with a firearm.
Stable Shot
Advantage on your next firearm attack before the end of your next turn.
Stable Shot
Without spending an action, sacrifice 20 feet of movement to gain Advantage on your next firearm attack before the end of your next turn.
Stable Shot
Unlocks the Stable Shot class action.
Pinpoint Accuracy
Gain +1 to hit at 50 feet or more, and +2 to hit at 70 feet or more.
Headshot
Spend 5 grit points. Your next firearm attack before the end of your next turn is an automatic critical hit.
Headshot
Your next firearm attack before the end of your next turn is an automatic critical hit.
Headshot
Unlocks the Headshot grit ability.
Infused Rounds

As a bonus action, infuse your firearm rounds with Fire, Thunder, Lightning, Acid, Cold, or Poison for 10 turns. Your firearm attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage of that type. Improved Infused Rounds raises this to 2d4 and adds Force; Mastered Infused Rounds raises it to 3d4 and adds Radiant and Necrotic.
Infused Rounds
Unlocks Infused Rounds: as a bonus action, infuse your firearm rounds with Fire, Thunder, Lightning, Acid, Cold, or Poison for 10 turns, adding 1d4 damage of that type to your firearm attacks.
Improved Infused Rounds
Infused Rounds damage increases to 2d4, and you can infuse your rounds with Force.
Arcane Reload
As a bonus action, concentrate to enchant your main-hand firearm so that it magically reloads one bullet at the start of each of your turns.
Arcane Reload
Concentrate to enchant your main-hand firearm. At the start of each of your turns, it magically reloads one bullet. Lasts until your concentration ends.
This firearm magically reloads one bullet at the start of its wielder's turn while they maintain concentration.
Mastered Infused Rounds
Infused Rounds damage increases to 3d4, and you can infuse your rounds with Radiant or Necrotic.
Smart Shooting
Add your Intelligence modifier to your firearm attack and damage rolls.
Unstable Backfire
An unstable round exploded in your face.
Unstable Infused Rounds

Requires an active infusion. For 10 turns, your infused rounds deal 5d4 damage of their element instead, but each firearm attack has a 25% chance to backfire, dealing 3d4 Force damage in a 5-foot radius centered on you.
Unstable Backfire
Deals 3d4 Force damage in a 5-foot radius.
Unstable Infused Rounds

Toggle on or off. While toggled on and an infusion is active, your infused rounds deal 5d4 damage of their element, but each firearm attack has a 25% chance to backfire, dealing 3d4 Force damage in a 5-foot radius centered on you. Has no effect while no infusion is active.
Spellstrike Shooter
When you cast a leveled spell using your action, you can make one weapon attack without spending an action.
Shoot Flintlock
Shoot Secondary Flintlock
Shoot Blunderbuss
Shoot Musket
Fire one bullet at a target in a straight line, dealing your firearm's weapon damage.
Fire one bullet from your secondary flintlock at a target in a straight line.
Primary Reload
Spend a bonus action to reload your flintlock to its full capacity of 3 bullets. If you have no bonus action left, it costs an action instead.
Secondary Reload
Spend a bonus action to reload your offhand flintlock to its full capacity of 3 bullets. If you have no bonus action left, it costs an action instead.
Primary Reload
Spend a bonus action to reload your blunderbuss to its full capacity of 2 shots. If you have no bonus action left, it costs an action instead.
Primary Reload
Spend a bonus action to reload your musket's single cartridge. If you have no bonus action left, it costs an action instead.
Full Reload
Spend your action to reload both of your dual-wielded flintlocks to full capacity.
Craft Flintlock
Spend a Gunsmithing Charge and your action to assemble a new Flintlock from spare parts.
Craft Blunderbuss
Spend a Gunsmithing Charge and your action to assemble a new Blunderbuss from spare parts.
Craft Musket
Spend a Gunsmithing Charge and your action to assemble a new Musket from spare parts.
Craft
Spend a Gunsmithing Charge and your action to craft a Flintlock, Musket, Blunderbuss, Assembly Kit, or Disassembly Kit.
Craft Assembly Kit
Spend a Gunsmithing Charge and your action to assemble an Assembly Kit, used to fuse a magical weapon to a firearm.
Craft Disassembly Kit
Spend a Gunsmithing Charge and your action to assemble a Disassembly Kit, used to separate a fused firearm and magical weapon.
Assembly Kit
A gunsmith's kit of fittings and tools used to fuse a magical weapon to a firearm.
Disassembly Kit
A gunsmith's kit of tools used to separate a fused firearm and magical weapon.
Misfired
This firearm has misfired. Its ranged attack rolls take a -2 penalty until it is repaired, it breaks, or you take a long rest. Another critical miss with it breaks it until your next long rest.
Misfire

When you roll a critical miss with this firearm, it misfires: attack rolls with it take a -2 penalty until it is repaired or you take a long rest. A critical miss with a misfired firearm breaks it, and it cannot fire until your next long rest.
Flintlock
A compact one-handed firearm. Holds 3 bullets.
Blunderbuss
A two-handed firearm with heavy, short-range stopping power. Holds 2 bullets.
Musket
A two-handed long-range firearm. Holds 1 bullet.
Bite the Bullet: 1 Grit
Bite the Bullet: 2 Grit
Bite the Bullet: 3 Grit
Spend a bonus action and 1 grit point. Gain <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag> equal to your proficiency bonus.
Spend a bonus action and 2 grit points. Gain <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag> equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
Spend a bonus action and 3 grit points. Gain <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag> equal to three times your proficiency bonus.
Merciless Shot: 1 Grit
Merciless Shot: 2 Grit
Merciless Shot: 3 Grit
Spend an action, 1 grit point and one bullet. Make a firearm attack that deals an extra 1d4 damage with a Flintlock, or 1d6 with a Blunderbuss or Musket.
Spend an action, 2 grit points and one bullet. Make a firearm attack that deals an extra 2d4 damage with a Flintlock, or 2d6 with a Blunderbuss or Musket.
Spend an action, 3 grit points and one bullet. Make a firearm attack that deals an extra 3d4 damage with a Flintlock, or 3d6 with a Blunderbuss or Musket.
Fanning Fire: 1 Grit
Fanning Fire: 2 Grit
Fanning Fire: 3 Grit
Spend an action, 1 grit point and two bullets to fire two shots, each at -2 to hit.
Spend an action, 2 grit points and three bullets to fire three shots, each at -3 to hit.
Spend an action, 3 grit points and four bullets to fire four shots, each at -4 to hit.
Tinkerer: Primary Capacity
Tinkerer: Primary Damage
Tinkerer: Primary Range
Tinkerer: Secondary Capacity
Tinkerer: Secondary Damage
Tinkerer: Secondary Range
Double this firearm's base ammunition capacity until this modification is replaced or removed. With Master Tinkerer, apply this again to triple its base capacity.
Add 1d4 to this firearm's damage rolls until this modification is replaced or removed. With Master Tinkerer, apply this again to add 2d4 to its damage rolls instead.
Increase this firearm's range until this modification is replaced or removed: Flintlock +20 feet, Blunderbuss +10 feet, Musket +40 feet. With Master Tinkerer, apply this again to double that bonus.
Tinkerer: Primary Remove Modification
Tinkerer: Secondary Remove Modification

Spend an action to remove all Tinkerer modifications from this firearm, including Tinker Master upgrades. Restore its base capacity, damage, and range without repairing misfires or damage to the firearm. Excess ammunition is discarded if its capacity decreases.
Scattershot

Spend an action and one bullet to blast a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus), taking half weapon damage on a failed save and no damage on a success.
Close Quarters
You gain a +1 bonus to ranged weapon attack rolls, and you don't have Disadvantage on ranged attack rolls when a hostile creature is within [1] of you.
Gunslinger's Draw
Your hand is always near your holster. You gain a +[1] bonus to Initiative.
Deadeye
When you land a Critical Hit with a firearm, the attack deals an additional [1].
Lock-on: New Target
Your locked-on target died. As a bonus action, lock on to a new creature while maintaining the same concentration.
A Gunslinger has locked on. Their firearm attacks deal additional damage equal to their proficiency bonus to this creature.
Master Tinkerer
Improved Critical
Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
Each firearm can hold two Tinkerer upgrades at once. Repeating an upgrade grants Tinker Master: Ammo, Damage, or Range. When a third upgrade is applied, the oldest is replaced.
Disarming Shot
Spend 1 grit and fire your firearm. On a hit, the target must succeed a Strength saving throw or drop its weapon.
Winging Shot
Spend 1 grit and shoot at the legs. On a hit, the target must succeed a Constitution saving throw or be knocked Prone.
Forceful Shot
Spend 1 grit and fire a heavy charge. On a hit, the target must succeed a Strength saving throw or be pushed back 4.5m.
Bullying Shot
Spend 1 grit and fire a menacing shot. On a hit, the target must succeed a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened for 1 turn.
Trick Shot
Choose one of four firearm shots: Disarming Shot, Winging Shot, Forceful Shot, or Bullying Shot. Each shot costs 1 grit, an action, and one bullet.
Quickload
Spend 1 grit to fully reload your main-hand firearm or off-hand flintlock, or 1 grit and a bonus action to reload both.
Quickload: Main Hand
Quickload: Off Hand
Quickload: Both Hands
Spend 1 grit to fully reload your main-hand firearm. Doesn't use an action or bonus action.
Spend 1 grit to fully reload your off-hand flintlock. Doesn't use an action or bonus action.
Spend 1 grit and a bonus action to fully reload both of the firearms you're wielding.
The next time you would be downed, you stay at 1 hit point instead and immediately make one firearm attack against your attacker.
Flash Powder
Spend 1 grit and throw a pinch of black powder into a flash. Creatures in a 1.5m radius must succeed a Constitution saving throw or be Blinded for 3 turns.
Violent Shot

Spend 1 to 3 grit to overcharge a shot. Each grit adds 1d8 (Flintlock), 2d6 (Blunderbuss) or 3d4 (Musket) damage. Roll a d20 afterwards: on a result equal to or lower than the grit spent, the firearm misfires.
Violent Shot: 1 Grit
Violent Shot: 2 Grit
Violent Shot: 3 Grit

Spend an action, 1 grit point and one bullet. Make a firearm attack that deals an extra 1d8 damage with a Flintlock, 2d6 with a Blunderbuss or 3d4 with a Musket. Afterwards roll a d20: on a result of 1 or lower, the firearm misfires.

Spend an action, 2 grit points and one bullet. Make a firearm attack that deals an extra 2d8 damage with a Flintlock, 4d6 with a Blunderbuss or 6d4 with a Musket. Afterwards roll a d20: on a result of 2 or lower, the firearm misfires.

Spend an action, 3 grit points and one bullet. Make a firearm attack that deals an extra 3d8 damage with a Flintlock, 6d6 with a Blunderbuss or 9d4 with a Musket. Afterwards roll a d20: on a result of 3 or lower, the firearm misfires.
Stunning Shot

Spend 2 grit and fire at the head. On a hit, the target must succeed a Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> or be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stunned</LSTag> for 1 turn.
Piercing Round
Spend 2 grit and fire a hardened round in an 18m line. Make an attack roll against each enemy and neutral creature (but not allies) in the line; every hit deals full weapon damage.
Hair Trigger
When an enemy within 9m attacks an ally, spend your reaction and 1 grit to shoot the attacker with your loaded firearm.
Grit and Steel
When you fail a saving throw, spend 2 grit to reroll it. Once per short rest.
Bullet Time
Spend 4 grit to gain an additional action this turn. Once per short rest.
Hail of Lead
Spend 5 grit and 1 ammunition to empty your firearm in a storm of shots. Make a weapon attack against every enemy within 18m. Once per long rest.
Final Judgement
Spend 4 grit and fire a fatal shot. If the hit leaves the target below 25% of its hit points, it takes weapon damage again and must succeed a Constitution saving throw or die.
Ante Up
Spend a bonus action and 1 grit to gain Advantage on your next firearm attack before the end of your next turn. If that attack misses, attacks against you have Advantage until your next turn.
Ante Up
Your next firearm attack has Advantage.
Lost the Ante
Attacks against you have Advantage.
Lucky Draw
Spend 1 grit to reroll 1s and 2s on your firearm damage dice until the end of your turn. Once per turn.
Reroll 1s and 2s on firearm damage dice.
Two-Gun Tango
Spend 1 grit to fire your off-hand flintlock. Doesn't use an action or bonus action.
Roll the Bones
Spend a bonus action and 1 grit to roll a d6. 1: -1d4 to your firearm attack rolls. 2-5: +1d6 damage on your next firearm hit. 6: +2d6 damage on your next firearm hit and regain 1 grit.
Bust
-1d4 to firearm attack rolls.
Lucky Roll
Your next firearm attack deals an extra 1d6 damage.
Jackpot
Your next firearm attack deals an extra 2d6 damage.
Duck and Weave
When a ranged weapon attack is about to damage you, spend your reaction and 1 grit to resist its physical damage, then Disengage and gain 3m of movement.
+3m movement until the end of your next turn.
Cheat Death's Odds
While you are below half your hit points, grit abilities that cost 2 or more grit refund 1 grit when used.
Hot Hand
Once per turn, when you hit with a firearm attack, spend 2 grit: your next firearm attack scores a Critical Hit on an 18-20.
Your next firearm attack scores a Critical Hit on an 18-20.
Double or Nothing

Once per turn, when you hit with a firearm attack, spend 2 grit to roll a d20. On 11 or higher, make a free firearm attack against the same target, consuming one bullet. Otherwise the firearm misfires.
Quick on the Draw
When an enemy within 9m starts an attack, spend your reaction and 2 grit to cancel it and shoot first with your loaded firearm. The enemy gets that attack back.
Ricochet Shot
Spend 3 grit and 1 bullet to fire a shot that ricochets between up to 4 enemies. The first target takes full weapon damage; each ricochet deals half weapon damage.
Dead Man's Hand
While you are below 25% of your hit points, spend 3 grit: your next firearm attack before the end of your next turn is a Critical Hit if it hits. Once per turn.
Your next firearm hit is a Critical Hit.
Desperado's Fortune
Desperado's Luck: Evolution

If you know Desperado's Luck, it evolves into Desperado's Fortune when you complete this level, without spending a grit ability choice. Fortune replaces Luck's 1d4 reaction with 1d8 after a missed firearm attack or failed saving throw. If you do not know Luck, Fortune is available as a normal grit ability choice instead.
Replaces Desperado's Luck. When a firearm attack misses or you fail a saving throw, spend 1 grit to add 1d8 to the roll. Once per turn.
High Noon

Spend a bonus action and 5 grit to call out an enemy for 3 turns. Your firearm attacks against it gain +20 to hit and score a Critical Hit on a 17-20. Your firearm attacks also deal an extra 1d8 damage. Once per long rest.
Last Man Standing

Once per short rest, when a firearm attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, you can spend 2 grit and 1 bullet to immediately attack another creature within range. If that attack reduces its target to 0 hit points, you can spend 2 grit and 1 bullet to repeat this effect. The streak ends when an attack fails to kill.
Last Man Standing

Once per short rest, after a firearm attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, spend 2 grit and 1 bullet to make a free attack with your main-hand firearm against a creature within range. This starts a chain that lasts for 2 turns or until you hit with a weapon attack other than Last Man Standing.
Last Man Standing
Your Last Man Standing attack killed its target. Spend 2 grit and 1 bullet to make another free weapon attack against a creature within range and keep the chain going.
Called Out
A Desperado has called this creature out at High Noon.
Firearm attacks against the called-out creature gain +20 to hit and score a Critical Hit on a 17-20. Your firearm attacks deal an extra 1d8 damage.
Hot Streak

Spend a bonus action and 3 Grit to start Hot Streak. All firearm attacks, including regular attacks and Hot Streak recast shots, deal an extra 1d4 damage. Each firearm hit increases the bonus by another 1d4, up to 10d4, and unlocks the next recast shot. Each recast uses one weapon attack and one bullet, and works with Extra Attack. Hot Streak ends when you miss an attack, take a long rest, or land the tenth chained firearm hit. Once per short rest.

All firearm attacks, including regular attacks and Hot Streak recast shots, gain another 1d4 bonus damage with each chained firearm hit. Ends on an attack miss, a long rest, or the tenth chained firearm hit.
Hot Streak Shot

Your firearm attacks deal an extra [1]d4 damage. A regular firearm hit or Hot Streak recast hit unlocks the next shot and increases the bonus. Ends on an attack miss, a long rest, or the tenth chained firearm hit.
Hot Streak

Fire one bullet from any equipped main-hand firearm: Flintlock, Blunderbuss, or Musket. Uses that firearm's damage, damage type, range, and ammunition, plus Hot Streak's current bonus damage. Uses one weapon attack and works with Extra Attack. A regular firearm hit or recast hit increases the bonus by 1d4 and unlocks the next shot. A miss, a long rest, or the tenth chained firearm hit ends Hot Streak.
Bloodletting
Fire one bullet from your main-hand Flintlock, dealing normal weapon damage and inflicting Bleeding for 2 turns on a hit. Once per short rest.
Incise Ligaments Shot

Fire one musket cartridge. On a hit, deal the musket's damage plus 1d6 firearm damage and the target must pass a Dexterity save (DC 2 higher than your Maneuver save DC) or become Slowed for 2 turns. Once per short rest.
Bonesaw Musket
A +1 musket fitted with Bonesaw's Incise Ligaments action.
Pushing Shot
Fire one musket cartridge. On a hit, the target must pass a Strength save against your Maneuver save DC or be pushed 5 metres. Once per short rest.
Titanstring Musket
A +1 musket that adds your Strength modifier to ranged weapon damage and grants Pushing Shot.
Absolute Power Shot
Fire one musket cartridge, dealing normal weapon damage and 1d6 Force damage. The target must pass a Strength save or be pushed 5 metres. Once per turn.
Faithbreaker Musket
A +1 musket fitted with Faithbreaker's Absolute Power action.
Hush You Shot
Fire one musket cartridge, dealing normal weapon damage. The target must pass a Constitution save (DC 2 higher than your Maneuver save DC) or become Silenced for 2 turns. Once per short rest.
Witchbreaker Musket
A +1 musket that grants Advantage on attacks against concentrating targets and Hush You Shot.
Watcher's Guide Musket
A magical musket that grants True Strike against a target after you miss it with an attack.
Corellon's Grace Musket
A magical musket that grants +1 to firearm attack rolls and damage and +2 to saving throws while you wear no armour.
Intransigent Musket
A magical musket that can knock nearby enemies Prone when you score a critical hit or kill a foe.
Jagged Spear Musket
A magical musket that can Torture targets on a hit, imposing Disadvantage on their Constitution saving throws.

Fire a musket shot that deals weapon damage. On a failed Constitution saving throw, the target is Paralyzed for 1 turn. Usable once per short rest.
